status: local callback address component qualified; installed/cloud path remains separate
scope: local loopback only; advertised URL configuration and owned proxy, no provider accounts or public ingress
behavior: Provider request carries the exact operator-advertised URL, and an independent real MCP client follows it through an owned local HTTP proxy to recall authorized source context.

The proxy rewrites backend Host and preserves Authorization, Origin and provider correlation. Wrong origin/host and absent bearer are rejected; cancellation denies subsequent callbacks. Host/origin validation was not weakened.
Actual native UCTP/QUIC duplex PCMU remains paired with the Vapi call while its task tools use the mapped callback.
Nine invalid URLs create no private intent, Store mutation or provider request. A saved HTTPS URL does not open public ingress; the listener stays loopback.
The durable task/session setup cannot be replaced by another callback URL. Server/proxy shutdown releases both listeners.
quality: Prepared source-lock inputs, formatting, affected strict Clippy and public server Rustdoc with warnings denied all pass; no inherited process-group members remain.

retained_attempts.outcome: Initial dependency compile stopped before callback tests: review found the raw TCP fixture retained a disallowed Host. Replaced with a documented HTTP proxy; no pass or test failure claimed for that interrupted compile.

The private provider simulator correctly rejected the fixture SDK key with HTTP 401. Corrected the fixture to the simulator's expected key and removed an unused mut; production authority checks were unchanged.

limits: Complete 39-phase 3a272c9 offline baseline predates this additive API.
This uses loopback simulators and a proxy fixture; it does not qualify actual Vapi cloud reachability, live provider/model behavior or a packaged release.

A pre-harness OS observation reported the owned callback test process as uninterruptible; a bounded sampling attempt timed out and the original process later completed. No cause is assigned to that observation or to the earlier separate CLI startup finding.
